bin.entry_last_is: the RAW pre-ln_f residual from a forward hook on ln_f's input - NOT hidden_states[-1], which is already post-ln_f, and NOT hidden_states[-2], which is block 23's INPUT (identical to block 22's output). Block 23's output appears at NO index of hidden_states, which is why the hook is required for exactly this one entry.

logit_lens.method: at each layer, the LAST token's RAW residual is pushed through the final ln_f and W_U. Technique: the logit lens (nostalgebraist, 2020).
logit_lens.approximation: Layers 0..23 are read through the FINAL layer's norm, which is not the norm they were trained to be read through, so their absolute logits are indicative, not the model's own. At the LAST layer it is NOT an approximation - it is the model's computation, and it matches the real logits to 4.78e-06 here. That is where the approximation ends.

verdict.reading: The smallest lead the true answer holds is -0.028545, at entry 23 (the output of block 22). Measured across float64, float32 and the 6-decimal rounding the vector dumps ship, this pipeline's numeric spread there is 6.02e-07, so the gap is 47390x the noise: the SIGN is robust and neither rounding nor float precision can flip it. Its MAGNITUDE is 0.3% of the peak lead of -9.0137. So it is a real but negligible lead, not a tie and not noise - the stack reaches the last block almost exactly balanced.
verdict.not_measured: This bounds the pipeline's NUMERIC noise only. The lens's INTERPRETIVE error at intermediate entries - reading a mid-stack residual through the final layer's norm - is not measured by this or anything else here, and no figure is invented for it.

erosion.biggest_note: biggest_mover_toward_rival is the largest delta AFTER the peak of the true answer's lead. biggest_mover_overall is the largest anywhere, which early in the stack is usually the embedding -> block 0 jump and is not an erosion.
erosion.reading: The true answer's lead peaks after 20 blocks (the output of block 19) at -9.0137, and is then eroded by 4 consecutive blocks totalling +10.9919. The single largest contributor is BLOCK 22 at +5.0876 (46.3% of the swing); the LAST block contributes +2.0067 (18.3%), acting when the lead is already down to -0.0285. So no single block destroys the answer - naming the last one would be reading the crossing as an attribution.
erosion.near_tie_caution: A |gap| far below the peak lead is a NEGLIGIBLE lead, not a tie: see the `precision` block, which measures whether this pipeline's own numeric noise could flip its sign. Calling it a tie was this page's first wording and it was wrong in the opposite direction - it invites a reader to treat a precise, tiny number as meaningless.

crossings_note: COMPUTED from the recorded curves, never authored. Empty means the sign of the gap never changed, which is a real outcome and is said as such (path A6).
no_cosine: The lens is a dot product W_U[t] . ln_f(resid). The per-layer residual norm is recorded beside it because it grows by more than an order of magnitude across the stack, and a direction-only view would hide that (R-VS-DEPTH).
replay_not_inference: No inference runs in the browser. The page replays this recording, so every frame is a measured activation and rewind is the same mechanism as play.
